reviewer: expansion_cards subagent; independent of context builder, author of sourced card draft
limits: Support names are additional annotation and must be shared between names-only and facts conditions.
Five conditions contain four unique text conditions because removal is exactly names-only; this is a valid paired inference diagnostic, not a fifth independent training treatment.
Background text is fixed per support-class direction across all 48 queries, not scene-specific agronomic evidence.
Swapped facts may create conspicuous semantic contradictions and are not a sufficient test of agronomic reasoning.
Generic context omits names; its comparison includes extra label semantics as well as facts. Primary facts attribution remains matched minus names-only.
Actual tokenizer length, text-to-mask connection, full EO gradient and performance are not verified by this review.
Acquired dates remain audit metadata in this projector; any future model use of dates must explicitly come from acquired observation inputs.
No immutable downloaded webpage byte snapshot and no independent agronomist or human correction review.
